area: timestamps speak when the user set the read location to None
breaks: a setting turned off is ignored: every arrow press prepends a timestamp the user switched off

area: the date stops being spoken on the day it changes
breaks: scrolling across midnight never announces the new date unless the user opted into it on every bar — the 2.7.0 'date only when it changes' behaviour silently becomes 'date never'

area: an empty series drops the prefix it was the only emitter of
breaks: the early return that was widened on purpose closes again: a series with no components swallows the caller's prefix, which is the only thing that would have been said

area: hidden AND muted collapses back to one word
breaks: the defect this class was written for, reintroduced: a component needing TWO keys names one, so the user presses h, is still silent, and is further from what they wanted

area: a muted component claims to be audible
breaks: visible-but-muted reads as ordinary — the terminal reporting a state it is not in

area: component selection inverted
breaks: when NO component has been singled out, none of them narrate — N on a whole series goes dead

area: approach suppression inverted
breaks: only the CONTRADICTORY approach clauses survive: 'price crossed above R1 at 103.50, approaching R1 at 103.50' is exactly what SuppressApproachFor exists to stop

area: the rarest signal is dropped and the commonest kept
breaks: tier order reversed, so the cap keeps TierReading and discards TierBreak — the 21st pass defect (the gold dot dropped from every playback) arriving through the other path

area: an undeclared level subscription narrates nothing
breaks: null means 'no declaration', which must mean every level. Flipped, every component that never declared a subscription goes silent on all of its levels

area: an explicitly empty subscription narrates everything
breaks: an empty list is a deliberate 'none' — flipped, an Oscillator narrates RSI's 50 and every other line on a scale it does not live on

area: everything is approaching everything
breaks: the proximity threshold is 100x, so every zone line announces an approach on every bar

area: a level touch re-announces on every bar
breaks: 'Price tested resistance, tested 3 times' repeats every bar for as long as the count holds

area: a named level loses its number
breaks: 'overbought, 70' becomes 'overbought' for every level that happens to sit at zero, and any level named 'zero' anywhere loses its value — a crossing with no price in it

area: the narrate-during-playback switch is inverted
breaks: turning narration ON during playback is what silences it

area: the landmark unit is chosen backwards
breaks: a daily chart announces an hourly landmark on every bar; a one-minute chart announces none

area: playback speaks no signals at all
breaks: the whole point of playback for a blind user — hearing what fired as the bars go by — returns nothing, silently and with no error

area: every bar is inside every zone
breaks: the 0.5% proximity window becomes 50%: every zone reads as active on every bar

area: the hit tester picks the farthest series under the cursor
breaks: with two lines in range it selects the one further from the cursor — a selection rule is only under test when at least two candidates compete (A2e's E09, other file)

area: clicks on the x-axis strip select a series
breaks: the strip is no longer excluded, so a click below the last pane reports a hit in it

area: a High-severity error no longer interrupts
breaks: a High error queues behind whatever is being read instead of cutting in — for a blind user an error that waits its turn is an error delivered after the decision it was about

area: a hidden component stops saying so on an X-scan
breaks: sweeping left/right across a HIDDEN component reads bare values as though it were on screen — the exact half of the 2026-09-04 report that said a hidden component must say so on every move

area: a muted series still narrates
breaks: M stops silencing a series for narration while it still silences its tone — the switch half-works, which is worse than not working

area: the clause cap is gone
breaks: a busy bar close becomes a 40-second uninterruptible sentence — the cap is the whole reason the eight-Speak-calls-per-scan defect stayed fixed

area: the live edge is never reached
breaks: an off-by-one that can never be true: playback never recognises that it has arrived at the live bar, so whatever that answer gates never happens

area: the component name is announced only when it did NOT change
breaks: moving Up/Down between a drawing's anchors stops naming the anchor you arrived at, and names it when you did not move — the 'every drawing point says what it is' work, undone

area: the hit tolerance is 12x tighter
breaks: click-to-select requires pixel-exact aim — the interaction is nominally present and practically unusable, which is the failure mode hardest to notice from a test
